浅青海水、奶油色沙滩和一间等着来信的小屋。: Turquoise water, a creamy beach and a cottage waiting for letters.

先点击收集一个物件，或直接把物件拖到这里。: Collect an item first, or drag one here.

放好了，继续寻找剩下的物件。: Placed. Keep looking for the remaining items.
装置启动了，最后的任务已经出现。: Mechanism activated. The final task is ready.
还差一点，看看装置旁的线索，再试一次。: Not quite. Read the clue beside the mechanism and try again.
暗号还没有对上。读一读线索，重新排列后再试。: The sequence does not match. Read the clue, clear it and try again.
本章已完成，其他章节也随时为你开放。: Chapter complete. Other chapters remain open whenever you wish.
走到三面航标旁，点击调整方向。: Click each of the three beacons to adjust its direction.
每个开关会翻转连着的灯，沿电线找找它们的关系。: Each switch toggles its connected lamps. Follow the wires to work out the connections.
先捡贝壳，经过浪花，再让海鸥捎信。: First the shell, then the wave, and finally the seagull.

点“六章地图”选择目的地。六章都能直接进入，可随时切换，进度分别保存。: Choose a destination from Chapter map. All six chapters are open, and each saves its own progress.

左上角显示当前学习目标；海边和圣诞顶部显示三步任务，底部显示下一步提示。: The upper left shows your current learning goal. Coast and winter show three tasks at the top and the next action below.

收下后可直接点本节装置放入，也可拖入；装置显示已整理/总数。点开还能定位未读内容: Place collected items in this section’s device by clicking or dragging. Its count shows filed items out of the total, and it can locate unread material.
